source_refs.claim: the retry strategy retries a retryable error up to s3_retry_attempts times
and an outer loop reissues the request up to s3_retry_attempts + 1 times: a request that always fails is sent (s3_retry_attempts + 1)^2 times
s3_retry_attempts defaults to 500: one injected failure is retried once and succeeds
